object-src-none.requirement: Mandatory directive object-src 'none' to block legacy plugin/Flash/Java execution vectors.
object-src-none.note: Observed directive matches MWG 0.0.193 requirement exactly.

frame-ancestors.requirement: Mandatory clickjacking defense via frame-ancestors 'self' or 'none', obsoleting X-Frame-Options.
frame-ancestors.note: Observed directive obsoletes missing X-Frame-Options per MWG 0.0.193.

base-uri.requirement: Mandatory base-uri 'self' (or 'none') to prevent <base href> injection and relative script hijack.

require-trusted-types-for.requirement: Mandatory require-trusted-types-for 'script' in Content-Security-Policy to enforce Trusted Types against DOM XSS (principles.json:723, 760).
require-trusted-types-for.note: Header omits require-trusted-types-for 'script'; DOM sinks are not locked to Trusted Types. Flagged as an issue under both secure-transport-and-headers and defensive-browser-policies (finding F18).

strict-script-src.requirement: Avoid 'unsafe-inline' / 'unsafe-eval'; prefer cryptographic nonces or hashes.
strict-script-src.note: Includes 'unsafe-inline' and host allowlists, weakening XSS mitigation per MWG 0.0.193.
